parsed.why: Pioneering trans law, X markers, care access restored, no traveller-facing restriction or facility ban. But gender-motivated aggravator refused, equality agency abolished, record hate-crimes and activists describing deterioration — reduced, not low.

Nationwide universal exposures: passport/visa marker refusal with fraud-ineligibility risk, statutory facility bans in many states, custody harm, officials framing transness as threat; allied states issued advisories. Courts and hate-crime law only partly offset.

Declaration-based recognition, discrimination law covering goods and services, hate-crime aggravator, case-by-case custody placement, no criminalisation, no documented trans-targeted violence; only gaps are gender-expression protection and unstated visitor document procedure.

Contested same-sex criminalisation, documented police arrests and torture, banned LGBTQ organising, no recognition or discrimination recourse, collapsed health system. Evidence is undated and not trans-specific, but state hostility without rule of law dominates.

Same-sex conduct criminalised with imprisonment and lashes, but no trans-specific offence; no enforcement documented since 2015, no officials complicit, tourist areas reportedly tolerant. Hostile official posture and no recourse keep it below 0.5.
